summary: SP-API workflow task: validate an approved price-change queue through Listings Items, apply still-valid immediate rows with patchListingsItem after VALIDATION_PREVIEW, create/poll/download a Reports API settlement report, create/upload/submit/poll/download a JSON_LISTINGS_FEED for still-valid batch rows, and persist evidence artifacts. Difficulty is API fluency and SP-API state-machine correctness, not margin arithmetic.
check_strategy: Verifier reads the final mock state through /__bench/state and /__bench/audit, evaluates the original fine-grained SP-API predicates, then folds them into stable capability checks by pure AND aggregation. Binary reward requires all capability checks to pass.

checks.description: The verifier can read the mock SP-API final state and audit log.
Still-valid immediate rows have saved VALID validation-preview responses, final listing prices updated through patchListingsItem to approved target prices, and matching listing patch audit entries.
A GET_V2_SETTLEMENT_REPORT_DATA_FLAT_FILE_V2 report was created for ATVPDKIKX0DER, polled to DONE, has a reportDocumentId, and has a matching audit entry.
outputs/settlement_report_sample.tsv contains a readable downloaded settlement report sample.
A JSON_LISTINGS_FEED was created for ATVPDKIKX0DER, processed to DONE, has a resultFeedDocumentId, and has a matching audit entry.
The feed input document exists, uses application/json, has an upload audit entry, and contains parseable JSON.
The uploaded JSON feed contains the correct seller header, sequential messages, exactly the still-valid approved FEED-channel rows, correct replacement prices, and no duplicate PATCH-channel rows.
Stale, non-buyable, and non-US-only approval rows are skipped with the expected reason codes.
The downloaded feed processing report is saved, and outputs/feed_submission.json matches the uploaded feed body.

notes: This replaces the earlier net-margin math version. The agent-visible request now tests SP-API mechanics: endpoint discovery, includedData selection, marketplace scoping, Listings PATCH validation preview and apply semantics, stateful write/retry discipline, report async polling, document download/decompression, feed document upload, createFeed 202 semantics, feed polling, result document retrieval, and exact JSON_LISTINGS_FEED construction. Capacity checks are stable capability groups; per-SKU and per-field details remain inside the verifier's diagnostic atoms.
